one_line: A persistent metacurrency (doubloons) shop where players spend accumulated currency on items to spawn with at roundstart or buy permanently, plus admin tools to adjust balances.
player_facing_mechanics: Browse a pre-round TGUI shop titled 'Spend Doubloons' listing items with name, cost, icon and icon_state
Buy a one-time pre-round item that spawns on your character at roundstart
See your current doubloon balance, shown already reduced by the cost of the item you have queued
Have the bought item placed in your hands, otherwise inserted into your backpack, otherwise dropped on the floor
Are warned and not charged if you lack funds or if spawning fails
Owned persistent items are stored in preferences.inventory and cannot be bought again via the normal store
Admins can add/subtract a chosen player's doubloons (clamped so balance cannot go negative)
Admins can mass-add doubloons to every connected player
Admins can check a player's current doubloon balance
data_only_parts: All /datum/store_item/roundstart subtypes: name, item_cost, item_path, one_time_buy stat overrides
The list of purchasable items (credits, medkits, toolboxes, improvised injectors/DNA mutators, implanters, antag tokens, etc.)
logic_parts: /datum/store_item/attempt_spawn spawning the item and handing it to the mob
/datum/pre_round_store/finalize_purchase_spawn deferred roundstart charging and item placement (hands/backpack/floor)
init_pre_round_items global list builder filtering one_time_buy subtypes
byond_specific: ADMIN_VERB macro and admin verb registration system
text2path, ispath, subtypesof, initial() operator usage
storing BYOND type paths directly as DB item_id values
client.prefs access and adjust_metacoins client-side currency calls
port_notes: The item catalog is essentially pure data and maps cleanly to SS14 YAML store/listing prototypes (name, cost, entity prototype id) driven by a StoreSystem. The behavior layers are what need real code: a currency system on the player's profile/bank (metacoins -> a MetaCoin or currency component), a UI system (the PreRoundStore TGUI becomes an SS14 BUI/Eui), purchase/charging logic, and spawn-on-roundstart placement that maps to spawn/equip events (hands -> hand container, backpack -> storage component insertion, floor -> drop). The DB persistence of owned items maps to SS14's player data / database layer rather than direct SQL. Admin balance adjustment maps to admin commands/variables. Design questions a human must answer: whether metacurrency is per-profile (as here) or per-character, how one-time vs repeatable purchases are enforced without a DB round-trip, how href-exploit validation is replaced (SS14 validates prototype ids server-side), and how antag tokens (antag_maker items) integrate with SS14 gamerules/antag selection.
